newsitem.title: UK: FirstBus places 80 mln stg bus order.
newsitem.headline: FirstBus places 80 mln stg bus order.

text.p: British bus operator FirstBus Plc said on Tuesday it had placed an order worth 80 million stg for 914 new buses from undisclosed suppliers.
The company said the majority of the single-deck and medium-sized, or "midi", buses in the order had "kneeling" suspension, which lowers them for ease of access.
FirstBus currently has a fleet of about 8,000 buses.
A total of 584 vehicles worth 50 million stg were ordered for the year ending March 31, 1998, with an initial order of 330 vehicles worth 30 million stg set for 1998-99, the company said.
The orders included about 423 double and single deck vehicles, 257 midi buses and 213 mini vehicles.
"Our improved specification sets a new benchmark for bus travel and will, I hope, accelerate the process of tempting drivers out of their cars," chief executive Moir Lockhead said in a statement.
The company added that it had invested 87 million stg in new vehicles since April 1995.
